title: Tex-Mex Caesar with Black Beans, Corn, Tomatoes & Tortilla Chips

steps.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place corn in a colander. Drain beans in the colander with the corn, rinse under hot water (from the tap) to thaw, and set aside to drain further.

Meanwhile, cut each tortilla into bite-sized strips and place on a large baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil, season with chili powder and salt, and toss to coat; spread out in a single layer. Place in the oven and bake, flipping once, until golden and crispy, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven.
While the tortilla chips are baking, finely grate Parmesan and place in a large bowl.
Peel and mince garlic; add to bowl with the Parmesan.
Juice lime into the bowl; add yogurt, oil, soy sauce, Dijon, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle; add to the bowl.
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl.
Chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces; add to the bowl along with the corn and beans. Toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Top with tortilla chips and enjoy!
